title: Newton Method for Multiobjective Optimization Problems of Interval-Valued Maps
summary: In this article, we propose a Newton-based method for solving multiobjective interval optimization problems (MIOPs). We first provide a connection between weakly Pareto optimal points and Pareto critical points in the context of MIOPs. Introducing this relationship, we develop an algorithm aimed at computing a Pareto critical point. The algorithm incorporates the computation of a descent direction at a non-Pareto critical point and employs an Armijo-like line search strategy to ensure sufficient decrease.
